subject: general
question: India has a ______ form of government.
solution:
The correct answer is __**parliamentary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Parliamentary:**

 
 
• India has a parliamentary form of government, also known as a Westminster system.
 
• In this system, the head of state (President) is different from the head of government (Prime Minister).
 
• The President is the nominal head of state, while the Prime Minister is the real executive authority.
 
• The Prime Minister is usually the leader of the party that commands a majority in the Lok Sabha (lower house of Parliament).
 
• The Prime Minister and the Council of Ministers are collectively responsible to the Lok Sabha.
 
• The government can remain in power as long as it enjoys the confidence of the Lok Sabha.
